task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Pick up the portable white fan and place it on the Coral mat ensuring it faces the robot.
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。手臂保持高稳定性，不变形，进入框架拿起便携式白色风扇并将其放置在珊瑚垫上，确保其面向机器人。
